source: GRAND_RESEARCH_BLUEPRINT.md sections 0, 8.0, 24.4-24.8; working defaults D-02..D-06, D-12 (approved 2026-10-14)
unit: scene graph (PS family: scene = one subset scene; pair id is the shard group)

bootstrap.note: scene-level resampling; one resample of scenes is shared across CFG levels (HD) and across arms (HE)

multiplicity.rule: a hypothesis is reported SUPPORTED only if its own decision rule passes AND its Holm-adjusted p < 0.05

HA.estimand: Delta t50 = t50(bind_given_pres) - t50(presence) at w = 7.5, restart D8
HA.ordering_prediction: presence ~ size < spatial < colour binding; the position of count is EXPLORATORY (declared before TEST)

HD.holm_slot: minimum-p rule: p_HD = min(1, 2 * min(p_presence, p_binding))
HD.secondary: layout (presence, size, spatial) shift larger than colour shift: EXPLORATORY
HD.chance_level: A0 computed separately at each w from independent seeds at that w
HD.dev_gate: >= 40 DEV scenes with >= 1 both-present base image at each w

HE.F: per image: mean over the constraint families present of presence (objects_present), count_ok, bind_given_pres, spatial_given_pres, size_given_pres; conditional families only when defined

diversity.contrast: A2 - A1 mean pairwise DINOv2 cosine distance over the 4 seeds

HE.decision: intersection-union: supported only if all three pass
HE.p_value: max of the three one-sided bootstrap p-values

quality_guard_dev.metric: HPS v2 (if available; else the owner must fix a replacement before the freeze)
quality_guard_dev.action: switch primary w_lo from 1 to 3 before TEST (amendment logged)

HF.within_type: Spearman(per-scene t_stab averaged over seeds, per-scene area under the commitment curve)
HF.support: concordance >= 0.8 AND Spearman CI > 0 for at least two types
HF.reject: concordance <= 0.5 OR all within-type CIs include 0 with upper bound < 0.15

exclusions: a job with a missing/corrupt output after one retry is excluded and listed in exclusions.csv with its reason; no outcome-dependent exclusion
missing_data: conditional outcomes undefined when objects are absent are not imputed; eligibility counts are reported for every estimate

duplicates.decision: OWNER_DECISIONS Q2 = A (2026-10-18), docs/R3_DECISION_LOG.md DL-33; implemented in src/dedup.py, applied by src/r3_analyze.py before every estimate
duplicates.R1_generation_dedup: core rows of one split with the same (normalised prompt text, CFG, steps, seed) are one generation and count once (124 such rows in the full manifests); kept: CAN before other variants, main benchmark before PS family, then smaller prompt id; branch/switch rows on a dropped base are dropped with it
duplicates.R2_duplicate_canonical_scenes: scenes of one split with the same normalised canonical prompt count once (PS family scene dropped: psD05_P duplicates sg_0091)
duplicates.R3_dev_test_overlap: TEST rows whose prompt text also occurs in DEV are excluded from TEST variant-level (S2) estimates (11 TEST CF-O items; 32 groups of identical DEV/TEST generations)
duplicates.benchmark_and_manifests: unchanged; duplicates are still generated (156 redundant generations, 0.6% of compute)

pre_test_status._note: fixed before TEST from DEV evidence (Addendum C C5 status note, DL-38/40/45); applied by r3_analyze.finalise

exploratory.HA: DEV precision gate failed (half-width 7.94 > 4); binding judge below the audit criterion

disclosure.HE: F includes judge types below the audit criterion (count, binding, spatial, size); presence-only F reported as EXPLORATORY sensitivity
disclosure.HF: type orderings include judge types below the audit criterion
disclosure.HD: binding estimand EXPLORATORY (judge criterion not met)
